entities.name: Kura
entities.description: Dragon spirit of Kamigawa, reincarnation of Jugan, guardian of the Jukai Forest.

entities.name: Jukai Forest
entities.description: Forest on Kamigawa that Kura guards.

entities.name: Towashi
entities.description: Kamigawa's booming metropolis whose growth encroaches on Jukai Forest.

entities.name: The Orochi
entities.description: Serpent race that resurrected Kura in her original form.

events.summary: Kura, reincarnation of Jugan, is resurrected by the orochi and gathers the essences of all the dragons into an egg, which hatches the reincarnations of all five dragons.
events.quote: She collected the essences of all the dragons and then placed them inside an egg

events.summary: Kura guards the Jukai Forest against incursions, especially from Towashi.
events.quote: continues to act as guardian of Jukai Forest

relations.quote: continues to act as guardian of Jukai Forest

rejected.note: Kura is the reincarnation of Jugan
rejected.quote: She is the reincarnation of Jugan
